title: The Secure lock on the gate
subtitle: 安全预防 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 安全预防（人与自然·灾害防范·安全与预防）
meta: 主题语境：安全预防（人与自然·灾害防范·安全与预防）　|　核心词汇：secure　|　正文 337 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 secure 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 the driver wrote of ① a secure lock on the gate in the timetable, and everybody in the station said at once that it was ② securer than the one named there the year before. Three days on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the driver, who never explained anything, had done it twice over and gone home; it was the secure ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the securest lock on the gate anybody in the station had ever seen, or so the timetable for February 1947 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too secure to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the passenger who had come to help; the secure ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the ticket at the far platform, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a secure future of the family, and said that no passenger in his right mind would call it ⑥ as secure as the future of the family they had once had in the old station. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was secure or not, and he said so.

By 1960 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the timetable. What the line asked for was ⑦ something secure, and nothing besides. The passenger from the next station called the whole plan ⑧ quite secure; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the timetable kept the names of the secure ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1963, year after year, she wrote of another secure lock on the gate in the same timetable, and the work, which took two days, seemed ⑨ securer than anybody had expected. ⑩ The securest future of the family in the whole station, she said in 1965, was the one she could never quite name; the secure ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 安全（前置定语 a secure lock on the gate：1953 年司机在时刻表里记下的那件安全的锁）
B. adj. 安全／稳妥（比较级 securer than：文中两处，一处比门上牢靠的锁，一处比预想）
C. adj. 安全／稳妥（最高级 the securest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 安全（表语 too secure to do：母亲觉得它太安全，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 稳妥（前置定语 a secure future of the family：叔叔把整件事称作一桩稳妥的前程）
F. adj. 稳妥（同级比较 as secure as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩一家稳妥的前程相比）
G. adj. 稳妥（后置定语 something secure：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 稳妥（受程度副词修饰 quite secure：那位乘客的评价）

items.q: a secure lock on the gate
the securest lock on the gate anybody
a secure future of the family
The securest future of the family in

answers.why: secure 意为“安全”，1953 年司机在时刻表里记下的是“一件安全的锁”，此处作前置定语 a secure lock on the gate。
secure 意为“安全”，此处用比较级 securer than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
secure 意为“安全”，时刻表上 二月 那行字说它是车站里最安全的一件，故用最高级 the securest lock on the gate。
secure 意为“安全”，母亲认为这件东西“太安全了，谁也用不上”，too secure to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
secure 意为“稳妥”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩稳妥的前程”，此处作前置定语 a secure future of the family。
secure 意为“稳妥”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩一家稳妥的前程一样稳妥”，同级比较用 as secure as。
secure 意为“稳妥”，时刻表上那半行字要的是“稳妥的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something secure。
secure 意为“稳妥”，邻车站来的那位乘客认为这套计划“相当稳妥”，quite 修饰原级 secure。
secure 意为“稳妥”，1963 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要稳妥”，故用比较级 securer than。
secure 意为“稳妥”，母亲 1965 年说的是“整个车站里最稳妥的那一桩”，故用最高级 the securest future of the family。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1953 年，司机在时刻表里记下了一件安全的锁。（a secure lock on the gate）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更安全。（securer than …）
母亲觉得它太安全，谁也用不上。（too secure to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩稳妥的前程。（a secure future of the family）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩一家稳妥的前程一样稳妥。（as secure as …）
到了 1960 年，时刻表上只剩半行字：要的是一件稳妥的东西。（something secure）
answers: In 1953 the driver wrote of a secure lock on the gate in the timetable.
Everybody said it was securer than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too secure to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a secure future of the family.
He said nobody would call it as secure as the future of the family they had once had.
By 1960 the timetable asked for nothing but something secure.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 secure 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1953 the driver wrote of a secure lock on the gate in the timetable, and nobody forgot it.
It was the securest lock on the gate in the station, or so the timetable says.
My mother thought it too secure to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a secure future of the family, and nobody argued with him.
The passenger from the next station called the plan quite secure, and everybody laughed.
The secure ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
